title: KAIROS — Unreleased Always-On Background Agent Daemon
description: KAIROS (Ancient Greek: 'at the right time') is an unreleased feature-gated mode found 150+ times in the Claude Code source leak from v2.1.88. It implements a persistent daemon that can operate in the background even when the Claude Code terminal window is closed. Key mechanisms: (1) Periodic <tick> prompts that regularly review whether new actions are needed without user prompt; (2) PROACTIVE flag for surfacing insights the user hasn't asked for and needs to see now; (3) 15-second blocking budget — shell commands running longer than 15s get auto-backgrounded so the agent unblocks; (4) Append-only daily logs (logs/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md) instead of rewriting MEMORY.md — prevents context thrash in long-running sessions; (5) Access to tools not available in normal Claude Code sessions. Internal comments suggest a teaser for April 1-7 and a full launch target of May 2026. Currently gated behind feature('KAIROS') flag — not user-activatable. Distinct from existing background agent patterns (Agent Teams, cron heartbeat) because it's a persistent daemon with autonomous tick-based proactivity, not a user-invoked session.

evaluation.reasoning: Unreleased feature discovered via Ars Technica coverage of a Claude Code source code leak. Extremely high capability expansion (90): a persistent autonomous daemon with tick-based proactivity, 15-second blocking budget, and append-only memory logs is conceptually transformative compared to the current cron-based heartbeat. However, integration complexity is low (30) because the feature is currently behind a server-side feature gate — not user-activatable regardless of version. Source confidence MEDIUM (secondary source; Ars Technica article, not official Anthropic documentation). The append-only log pattern (logs/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md) is independently valuable and could be adopted for the current heartbeat without KAIROS activation. Research: verify whether the gate is client-side (env var hackable) or server-side (not), watch for official May 2026 launch announcement, investigate Coordinator Mode as companion feature.
research_questions: Is the KAIROS feature gate client-side (env var) or server-side (Anthropic-controlled)? Can it be activated on v2.1.101+?
